_doc: Symbol-rename map. Walk-back canonicalises all PR symbols to the chain's terminal `new` BEFORE applying events, so a rename does not produce two duplicate intervals. effective_date is informational; the rename is treated as a global identity collapse, not a per-date event.
_method: Verified by checking (a) old symbol present in PR events but absent from authoritative current niftyindices.com CSV, (b) new symbol in CSV at same listing slot, (c) public NSE notice referenced the rename.
